t: Large, modular, stackable Toughcase, designed for secure storage of accessories, with easy bit removal and replacement. Clear lid for easy bit identification. Contains a selection of bits including Extreme SDS Plus masonry drill bits, designed with a Toughcore tapered central core, increasing stability and durability and reducing breakage. Screwdriver bits feature optimised tip geometry for full fitment in the fastener and reduced cam-out. Can be connected and securely stacked with small, medium and large Toughcases via the locking system. Attach to a TSTAK for a complete system solution.
b: Contents: 5 Masonry Bits, 6 HSS-G Bits, 5 Flatwood Bits, 66 Driver Bits, 2 Nut Setters & Compact Magnetic Drive Guide.
Suitable For Use with SDS Plus or 3-Jaw Chuck Machines on Rotary Action
